function: Vehicle Action 0x40ea20 (thiscall this=unit, act, v1, v2; ret 0xc)
notes: see tools/oracle/gen_actions.py: vid 1 = the unit (len* = animation lengths, woundChild = childNvid[13]), vid 2 = target (Static, category 4, 20x20, in the grid and the unit list), vid childNvid = turret child (linkedObjectVid = childNvid when hasChild; 0x58.. for the Kassandra, whose act_coor_attack uses the head's childrenCount[8] = childShots); weapon w*; target fields: 0 none, 1 the target sprite, 2 the unit, 3 another pointer; v1ref: 0 = v1 literal, 1 = v1 = the target, 2 = the unit; v2ref likewise for v2 (act_damage: the source); ret -1001/-1002 = returned the target/the unit; createUnitCalls = calls to the stubbed CreateUnit (returns 0); crash = the original read past the end of the sub-object chain in 0x40c0e0 (wound effect missing: outputs after the fault are meaningless); inputBits = bits of the local input record 0x43d045
